title: elymus antiquus
intro: Elymus antiquus, commonly known as the Wild Wheat or Elymus, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Elymus antiquus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which may help to soothe coughs, relieve congestion, and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Elymus antiquus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
